name: A&J Supply
old_description: A&J Supply is a family operated Farm & Ranch Supply business since 1968. A trusted name that serves a five state area: South Dakota, North Dakota, Wyoming, Montana, Nebraska for over 50 years.
about:
A&J Supply has operated from Whitewood, South Dakota, since 1968 as a family-owned farm and ranch supply business. The company serves a five-state region spanning South Dakota, North Dakota, Wyoming, Montana, and Nebraska.

The business stocks and sells a broad range of products for agricultural and rural customers. Its inventory includes unfinished steel such as angle iron, flat bar, square and round tubing, sheet and plate, expanded metal, and hot- and cold-rolled rounds and pipe. It also carries pressure-treated wood posts, poles, timbers, and boards; general hardware covering plumbing, tools, electrical, paint, automotive, and fasteners; farm and ranch supplies including roller chain, clevises, welding supplies and gases, livestock bedding, and tie-down chain; and workwear from brands such as Carhartt, Levi, Wrangler, Muck Boots, Justin Boots, and Ariat.

Primary customers are farmers, ranchers, and rural property owners across the northern Plains and Mountain West. The company also serves contractors and hobbyists who need metal, lumber, hardware, and welding supplies in the region.

A&J Supply emphasizes its long-standing local presence and family operation as differentiators, promoting quality products at reasonable prices backed by over 50 years of customer service in the same community.
